edits.old: Scenario: AC11 Replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key (exception X7)
edits.new:
Scenario: AC7 Repeat of a request with the same Idempotency-Key (exception X7)
    Given a request with an Idempotency-Key has already been applied
    When the same request is repeated with that Idempotency-Key
    Then one replacement exists, the repeat answers that record and no second write is made

  Scenario: AC8 Statement or test reaching a v_ace_* view, a recovery_case row or another service's schema (exception X8)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a v_ace_* view, a recovery_case row or another service's schema
    Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC9 Each business rule BR1 to BR10 has a criterion and a test case
    Given the business rules in section 8
    When the criteria in section 7 and the test cases in section 16 are read
    Then every rule BR1 to BR10 is covered by at least one criterion and one test case; proposed test: Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S9-E6032-APP-AC9)

  Scenario: AC11 Replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key (exception X7)
